**Geometry:** Architectural Rev F · Structural Phase 2 Rev A + M1 · **Services:** Drainage DR1 · HVAC HV1 · Schedule of Finishes FN1 · Structural CAD SC1

---

Master rule M.6 governs this register: *never guess missing engineering
information; if something is marked UNRESOLVED or NOT AVAILABLE it stays that way
until the user supplies it.*

Nothing in this package resolves an item that the master leaves open, and nothing
downgrades or deletes an evidence tag. This register lists what the Works Management
package assumed in order to produce a programme and a bill, and what must be
confirmed before either is relied on.

## Part 2 — Programme assumptions

| Ref | Assumption |
|---|---|
| `WM-P1` | Project start Monday 2 November 2026, carried over from the supplied R0 schedule. A planning date, not a contractual one |
| `WM-P2` | All output rates are assumed. The quantities they are applied to are confirmed or derived and are traceable; the rates are not |
| `WM-P3` | Rock excavation programmed at the mean rockhead (-)1.750. At the shallow bound it rises to 1 043 m³ and the excavation lengthens by about a day |
| `WM-P4` | No blasting. Rock is removed by hydraulic breaker because the sentry post founds on the same rock within 10 m |
| `WM-P5` | Vendor lead times are assumed. They are the largest single risk in the programme and must be replaced by quoted times at tender |
| `WM-P6` | Six-day working week with five date-certain national holidays. Festival holidays are absorbed by the 10-day contingency activity `A14098` |
| `WM-P7` | Monsoon is handled by productivity allowances inside durations and by sequencing the deep excavation and external tanking outside June–September, not by a non-working calendar |
| `WM-P8` | The berm, access route and concealment works have no site plan behind them, so their durations are indicative |
| `WM-P9` | Cement at 400 kg/m³ for M35 against the IS 456 Table 5 minimum of 340. A trial mix to IS 10262 fixes the real content |

## What this package did not do

* It did not run STAAD.Pro. STAAD.Pro is not available in this environment, and no
  analysis was performed. Reading a `.std` file is not running an analysis.
* It did not modify any drawing, model, calculation or design file. The only files
  changed outside the `WORKS MANAGEMENT` folder are `master/MASTER_PROJECT_STATE.md`
  (Part H revision record) and `master/QUICK_STATE.md`.
* It did not change the main staircase. The frozen geometry — 24 risers at
  170.8333, tread 280, three flights of eight, total rise 4100, flights 1200 wide,
  200 well, 2533 headroom — is unchanged and is reproduced in the programme as it
  stands.
* It did not resolve, downgrade or delete a single evidence tag from the master.
* It made only one design change, SP-B1, and made it because it was explicitly
  instructed.
